identified_ambiguity: Equal component weighting would assign 0.20 to the very small high-precision part stratum, while loading all 5808 rows as one component would instead make the numerous counterfactual attribute rows dominate by row count. Neither interpretation implements the already recorded five-stratum pilot prior.

reduction_contract.within_component: unweighted mean over the SHA-bound query rows of that component
reduction_contract.across_components: weighted mean using explicit positive finite component weights, normalized by their runtime sum
reduction_contract.descriptor_triplet: computed once and unchanged because it has no query component axis
reduction_contract.single_primary_only: normalization makes the primary component retain exact unit effective weight
reduction_contract.row_duplication: uniform row duplication within a component cannot change its component weight
